comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Regulated electric and gas utility serving end customers under tariffs; BKV is an upstream gas producer.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated gas and electric distribution plus propane retail; no upstream production or Barnett-style wells.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Coal mining and coal-fired power; different fuel and no natural gas production or gathering.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Fee-based Permian midstream processor; shares gathering and water services but BKV is a producer selling its own gas.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regulated New Jersey gas utility with appliance service plans; no production, gathering or power plant.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Crude oil refining and retail fuel marketing; downstream, not natural gas production.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution and propane delivery to homes; no upstream wells or power generation.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Rents mobile turbines and sand logistics to oilfield customers; does not produce gas or sell its own power.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Regulated electric utility in New Mexico and Texas; generation is for regulated customers, not gas production.
